status: Retrospective research; 2026 has already been examined. No untouched holdout or live track record.
primary_test: Technical + fixed-fiscal earnings + Bloomberg social versus Technical + fixed-fiscal earnings, same eligible stocks and dates, 20 US-session non-overlapping holds, 2026, 10 bps per one-way traded notional.
universe: Current wiki watchlist, US Equity listings with Bloomberg CRNCY USD; not historical index membership. Financial-reporting currency does not determine eligibility. Survivorship and selection bias remain.
features: All source observations dated before the signal session; trade at next session close. Technical windows use only past bars. Fixed annual target = signal calendar year + 1 for both estimate observations.
portfolio: Equal-weight top quintile, long-only; same-date eligible equal-weight basket and QQQ total return benchmarks. Bottom quintile spread is a gross diagnostic, not an implementable short strategy.
weights: Equal weights inside and across pillars, specified before running the new tests; no optimization.
consensus_availability: Last observed estimate can be carried at most 35 calendar days, never backward-filled. Original observation dates are retained. A stricter 10-day bound is reported as sensitivity. No filled value means no qualifying signal.
data_corrections: Initial diagnostic run caught reporting currency being confused with trading currency for SMIC. Corrected using Bloomberg CRNCY and US listing IDs before delivery. Sparse holiday-period estimate observations motivated an explicit bounded carry-forward rule, with strict-age sensitivity retained. Neither correction selects a rule by its profitability.
cost_grounding: ESTIMATE / scenario, not calibrated execution costs. Includes initial purchases, drift-aware rebalances and final liquidation; no market-impact model.
secondary_tests: 5-session holds; 2024, 2025 and 2026 separately; RSI, momentum, earnings, social and attention alone; paired additions of parsed sell-side and curated X on their shorter matched samples.
uncertainty: Paired moving-block bootstrap of holding-period excess returns, keeping the entire cross-section together; intervals are exploratory and not multiple-testing adjusted.
adoption_rule: An alpha case requires positive incremental net return, a positive lower bound of the paired primary interval, consistent year signs and no failed numerical guardrails. Even a statistical pass remains provisional because data-vintage and watchlist biases are unresolved.

relative_context_test.specified_on: 2026-10-28; design specified before new relative-context outcomes were computed
relative_context_test.primary: TES composite; 52-week strictly prior weekly score history; current wiki default peer groups; 2026 5- and 20-session company outcomes reported separately. All results retrospective.
relative_context_test.bands: Low P<30; middle 30<=P<70; high P>=70. Midrank percentile=100*(strictly lower + half ties)/valid N. No threshold or weight optimization.
relative_context_test.availability: Own history needs at least8 prior valid weekly readings within364 calendar days. Peers exclude own name and missing scores; minimum1, flag below3. Peer membership is current, not historically reconstructed.
relative_context_test.schedule: Reuse fixed non-overlapping company-study schedules. Inputs before signal; next-session close entry; exit exactly5 or20 QQQ sessions later. US USD listings only for outcomes. At historical replay include only exits at or before selected information cutoff.
relative_context_test.statistics: Per company and axis: mean, median, positive fraction and matched eligible unconditional mean; high-minus-low difference in percentage points. Alternative stock-minus-QQQ basis. Whole scheduled event rows resampled with fixed4/2-period circular blocks for5/20 sessions,1000 draws. Suppress company interval below20 usable events or5 in either extreme. Exploratory95% intervals, unadjusted for multiple comparisons. Valid bootstrap-draw count is disclosed; suppress if fewer than90% retain both extremes. Fixed sensitivity doubles block lengths to8/4 periods. Full master schedules retain ticker-missing and date-cluster-missing placeholders.
relative_context_test.secondary: 2024,2025,pooled history; other indicators; YTD/13w/26w historical windows; user-selected peers; joint3x3 buckets. Across-stock mean same-date high-minus-low spread with at least5 names in each extreme and date-block intervals; also minimum3 valid peers sensitivity. No cross-stock claim is substituted for the selected company result. Date-cluster intervals require at least20 dates, clarified by independent design review before running the new tests.
relative_context_test.grounding: Bloomberg raw returns HARD; original vintages and parsed text PARTIAL. Bands, minimum counts, lookbacks and block lengths ESTIMATE research-design choices, not calibrated predictive constants.
relative_context_test.interpretation: No net trading strategy, causal claim or untouched out-of-sample validation. Gross conditional association can reflect market regimes, stock composition and factor exposures; high hit rates alone are not predictive evidence.
relative_context_test.reference: Bailey et al., The Probability of Backtest Overfitting,2015: https://www.davidhbailey.com/dhbpapers/backtest-prob.pdf

individual_indicator_ranking.features: RSI14; symmetric fixed-FY EPS revision28d (no sales); Bloomberg post-weighted X tone over observed days in the prior7 calendar days; Bloomberg observed post counts over that window (not attention growth). Weekday-only vendor observations do not certify full-X/weekend coverage. No missing weekends imputed as zero.
individual_indicator_ranking.matching: Four raw series compared on the same eligible return dates per company/axis/horizon. Strictly prior historical reference snapshots and same-event peer reference names must have all four raw values. Own reference needs8 readings; peer reference needs1, flag below3. Missing scheduled rows remain placeholders.
individual_indicator_ranking.primary: 2026 completed outcomes; gross stock return; own364-day history and current default wiki competitors or named-sector fallback;5/20-session nonoverlapping next-close holds, Low P<30, High P>=70.
individual_indicator_ranking.ranking: Rank absolute high-minus-low mean-return spread separately by company/axis/horizon. Direction is chosen retrospectively and explicitly labelled high-better or low-better. Sparse estimates can rank but are not robust; no automatic trading interpretation.
individual_indicator_ranking.uncertainty: 2000 deterministic circular-block draws, block4/2 for5/20sessions, doubled8/4 sensitivity. Minimum20 usable events and5 per extreme; suppress inference if<90% draws retainboth extremes. Approximate two-sided centered-bootstrap p=(1+count(abs(resampled_spread-observed_spread)>=abs(observed_spread)))/(valid_draws+1). Take maximum short/long p, then Holm acrossfixed16 hypotheses percompany(4indicators*2axes*2horizons), retaining unavailable hypotheses as p=1.
individual_indicator_ranking.robustness: Both block lengths independently require>=90% valid draws; failure sets family p=1. Show95% intervals, valid draws, tail counts and approximate Holm16 p. Monte Carlo Wilson95% bounds on each tail proportion (plus-one transformation) propagated through max(short,long) then Holm; flag MC borderline if interval spans.05; passing screen requires upper bound<=.05. Leave-one-out across EVERY eligible high/low event with fixed bands; require all signs stable and remaining n>=20, each extreme>=5. Supported year requires n>=10 and>=3 each extreme;>=2 supported years including selected/latest, all matching selected sign. Never use future years relative to selected period. Earlier-year direction needs>=20 observations and5 per extreme, selected/latest year>=10/3. All six gates must pass; chronological check remains retrospective. No cross-company or manual-selection/period multiplicity correction: badges are explicitly within-company screening only, never global significance.
individual_indicator_ranking.grounding: Raw Bloomberg observations HARD as retrieved; historical vintages PARTIAL. Windows,bands,minimumcounts,bootstrap choices and robustness gates ESTIMATE design rules. No calibrated predictive constant or causal claim.
individual_indicator_ranking.design_review: Independent skeptic design review incorporated before computing new outcomes: extreme-event leave-one-out, explicit weekday-only X coverage, local family16, separate validity gates and Monte Carlo precision bounds. Common reference dates AND peer names require all four raw fields.
